title: Add Breadcrumbs
content: Create breadcrumb navigation component with horizontal list of links showing page hierarchy. Use nav element with aria-label="Breadcrumb". Style: flex items-center gap-2 text-sm. Links: text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 transition-colors. Separators: ChevronRight icon (w-4 h-4 text-gray-400) or "/" text between items. Current page: text-gray-900 font-medium, use aria-current="page". Truncation: for long breadcrumbs, show first, ellipsis dropdown, and last 2-3 items. Mobile: consider horizontal scroll or collapsing to current + parent only. Add Home icon for first item optionally.

variants.simple: Create breadcrumb navigation showing the current page location in hierarchy.
variants.detailed: Create breadcrumb navigation component with horizontal list of links showing page hierarchy. Use nav element with aria-label="Breadcrumb". Style: flex items-center gap-2 text-sm. Links: text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 transition-colors. Separators: ChevronRight icon (w-4 h-4 text-gray-400) or "/" text between items. Current page: text-gray-900 font-medium, use aria-current="page". Truncation: for long breadcrumbs, show first, ellipsis dropdown, and last 2-3 items. Mobile: consider horizontal scroll or collapsing to current + parent only. Add Home icon for first item optionally.
variants.advanced: Create accessible breadcrumb navigation component. Structure: nav element with aria-label="Breadcrumb", ol for list (semantically correct for ordered navigation), li for each item. Styling: flex items-center gap-1 md:gap-2 text-sm text-gray-500. Links: hover:text-gray-900 hover:underline underline-offset-2 transition-colors. Separators: ChevronRight icon (w-4 h-4 text-gray-300 flex-shrink-0) between items using aria-hidden="true". Current page: span (not link) with text-gray-900 font-medium and aria-current="page". Smart truncation: for 5+ items, show Home, ellipsis button with dropdown showing hidden items, last 2 items. Dropdown: absolute positioned, bg-white shadow-lg rounded-md py-1, each item px-3 py-2 hover:bg-gray-100. Mobile responsive: on small screens (sm:), show only current page with back button, or horizontal scroll with scrollbar-hide. Home icon: optional Home icon (w-4 h-4) for first item with sr-only "Home" text. JSON-LD: add structured data schema BreadcrumbList for SEO. Component props: items array [{label, href, icon?}], separator component, maxItems before truncation. Handle dynamic routes with loading state for async breadcrumb data.
